5107-5261-7170.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
5107-5261-7170.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
5107-5261-7170.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Living Brain.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

4247-4452-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4247-4452-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

132-1379-4687-5116.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-1379-4687-5116.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Gilded Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

2749-4551-8089.description:
Activate Wall of Blood by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

567-1981-2415-2511.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
567-1981-2415-2511.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

654-1308-3129-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

884-3375-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ayara triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Ayara trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Ayara trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
884-3375-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

670-1619-3742-6151.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6151.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing Underdark Explorer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Underdark Explorer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Underdark Explorer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling Underdark Explorer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

957-4423-6886-7705.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
957-4423-6886-7705.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat during your second extra turn
957-4423-6886-7705.notes: You can activate Dust Bowl and cast Time Stretch on alternating turns to spread the mana cost slightly, down to {8}{U}{U} and {3} alternating.

4302-5929-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-5929-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Leyline of Transformation, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

997-4694-7652.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

6798-7430--5.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat
6798-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

3188-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3188-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1978-3784-5776.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be used to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat

1012-4871-5220-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
1012-4871-5220-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

5056-6871-7033.description:
Cause Bumi to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Deal combat damage to an opponent. Bumi triggers, untapping all lands you control, including Bumi as it's a land due to Toph, and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat step 2 each combat phase.

1479-2841-6157-6517.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-6517.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Dragonback Assault and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2292-2324-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1379-1978-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 3 or greater.
1379-1978-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bighorner Rancher.
Repeat

2498-5078-6900.description:
Activate Sense's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library from the battlefield.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-6441-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-6441-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-2421-3705-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix and Birgi trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Skyfire Phoenix trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3817-4681-5231.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, targeting Sister Hospitaller.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
Resolve the Karmic Guide ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4484-4871-5147-5643-6747.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
4484-4871-5147-5643-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
4484-4871-5147-5643-6747.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Goblin Bombardment abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
4484-4871-5147-5643-6747.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1741-2713-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {C}
1741-2713-4013.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

56-4556-5256-6248.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-4556-5256-6248.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Blight Mound and Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-4556-5256-6248.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

2590-3967-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature
2590-3967-5776.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2068-4283-4404.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken creature.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
Whisper does not have summoning sickness.
2068-4283-4404.description:
Activate Whisper by tapping it, sacrificing Corridor Monitor and any other creature you control, targeting any other creature card in your graveyard.
Ashnod the Uncaring triggers, copying Whisper's ability, targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the copy of Whisper's ability, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Whisper.
Resolve the original Whisper ability, returning the targeted creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-864-1541-2292-5220.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Eternal Witness on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Eternal Witness from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating seven tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Eternal Witness and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers seven times and Eternal Witness triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

913-2367-2440-2471-3490.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Servos.
You control at least one additional artifact creature.
913-2367-2440-2471-3490.description:
Activate Zabaz's first ability by paying {R}, destroying another artifact creature you control.
When the creature dies, Unruly Mob triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Signpost Scarecrow by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control three or more Servos to start the combo, this combo nets infinite mana.

1003-2644-4763-5147.description:
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
When Phyrexian Walker enters the battlefield, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching Sai of the Shinobi to Phyrexian Walker.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1220-1636-2108-5220.notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
1220-1636-2108-5220.description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Bottle Golems.
When Bottle Golems dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Bottle Golems trigger, causing you to gain life equal to its power.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bottle Golems on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Bottle Golems from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Bottle Golems enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1770-2788-3634-4377.notablePrerequisites: You haven't cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1770-2788-3634-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Double Vision triggers, copying Walk the Aeons.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Walk the Aeons to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

539-1636-3346-4081-5220.notablePrerequisites: Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-3346-4081-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Mothdust Changeling.
When Mothdust Changeling dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Mothdust Changeling and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Mothdust Changeling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

3789-4131-4893.notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
3789-4131-4893.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Blackstaff of Waterdeep by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

4289-4684-4824.notablePrerequisites: Soliton does not have summoning sickness.
4289-4684-4824.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Dutiful Replicator

1562-4919-5159.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Mishra triggers, creating a token copy of the Machine God's Effigy (which is a copy of Dutiful Replicator), except it is a 4/4 Construct artifact creature with haste named Mishra's Warform.
When Mishra's Warform enters the battlefield, its Dutiful Replicator ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Mishra's Warform using the Machine God's Effigy ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Mishra's Warform trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Mishra's Warform.
Repeat from step 2.

186-3099-3767-4587.notablePrerequisites: You control a Sliver that does not have summoning sickness.
186-3099-3767-4587.description:
Activate any Sliver by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate the tapped Sliver by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
Once you have a large amount of mana, you may use it to activate Leyline of Abundance, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

1211-1371-3189.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1211-1371-3189.description:
Cast Doomsday by paying {B}{B}{B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Doomsday.
Resolve the first opponent's Doomsday, searching their library and/or graveyard for any five cards, exiling them due to Opposition Agent, exiling the rest of their library and graveyard, and causing them to lose half their life, rounded up.
Repeat step 3 for each other opponent.

1518-1987-3277.notablePrerequisites:
Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
You control an artifact and/or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {U}.
1518-1987-3277.description:
Activate Will's second ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing target player to draw two cards and causing all instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less this turn.
Activate the aritfact and/or land by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking Izzet Chronarch and the artifact and/or land.
Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, returning Ghostly Flicker from the graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
